name: Azure
desc: A parallel-track crash course mapping everything you already know from AWS onto Azure -- same concepts (object storage, IAM, managed Spark), new vocabulary and a few genuine structural differences.
tip: Every strong Azure answer starts with the AWS mapping, then names the one real structural difference -- e.g. 'Blob Storage is S3, but Resource Groups have no AWS equivalent -- deleting one deletes everything inside it at once.' That's what proves you're reasoning, not just memorizing new button names.
